kicker: The conductor brief · 23 · the night in review
title: The night: your RC1 review, routed while you slept
when: 30 October 22:00 to 31 October 07:00 UTC, from the git log of dev
headline: The team never stopped. Between 22:00 and 07:00, 121 commits from members and 55 site releases reached dev. You gave your paper review of RC1 (ten batches, pages 1 to 45) and your voice memo, and the team turned them into rules, tasks and two studies: the book's name and structure (NS1) and the book as JSON (J1). RC1 was locked; RC2 began.
